notes.title: Hob's Barrow Physical Edition, Soundtrack on Vinyl, and Art Print!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone!

The beautiful [url="https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop/p/h-s-j6x6-yw664obbsw"]Hob's Barrow deluxe physical edition[/url] for Nintendo Switch is still available for pre-order from Lost in Cult! Stock is getting quite limited now so do have a look if you are interested!

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596967/cd95ae9296c855703f591b5f175daa881312e271.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The soundtrack vinyl is also still available for pre-order via [url="https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop/p/hobs-vinyl"]Lost in Cult[/url] or [url="https://stumpyfrog.com/"]Stumpy Frog Records[/url]! It features haunting sleeve art by the legendary [url="https://hollow-press.net/collections/plastiboo"]Plastiboo[/url], who also created the new packaging art for the deluxe Switch physical release above.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596967/3cccb6bbda56b3c51083329af6ab27302a0b94db.png"][/img][/p][p]A very limited number of [url="https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop/p/h-print"]art prints[/url] have also been made available featuring beautiful new artwork by Jessica Seamans. 
[/p][p]You can check these all out via the Lost in Cult shop [url="https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop"]here[/url]. If you are interested in all three of the above, there is also a [url="https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop/p/hobs-collection-x37df"]bundle available[/url] which offers a discount. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596967/5ff1b193f1e565370c0352e9a66da2ae6e5989cd.png"][/img]

The vinyl is also available directly from [url="https://stumpyfrog.com/"]Stumpy Frog Records[/url]. We recommend checking via Stumpy Frog and Lost in Cult to see which option has better shipping rates for your country. 

We were very fortunate to work closely with Lost in Cult on these very high end physical releases, and we are so proud to be able to offer them to you.

Thanks for your support,[/p][p]
Shaun
Cloak and Dagger Games[/p]

notes.title: Pre-order the physical edition of Hob's Barrow for Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We are absolutely delighted to announce a [url=www.lostincult.com]very special physical release[/url] of The Excavation of Hob's Barrow for Nintendo Switch, thanks to our friends at Lost in Cult! 

We have worked closely with Lost in Cult to create a phenomenal limited edition physical release as part of their brand new EDITIONS series.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596967/cd95ae9296c855703f591b5f175daa881312e271.jpg[/img]

The EDITIONS version is limited to 3,000 copies and includes:

- An outer sleeve featuring haunting art by the acclaimed artist Plastiboo (Vermis, Godhusk)
- Variant game cover art also by Plastiboo
- Poster, featuring beautiful brand new art by Jessica Seamans (also available separately!)
- 40 page booklet containing an essay, concept art and a developer interview
- 4 art cards
- Sticker
- Director's authenticity card

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596967/a938a45701c2af275bda43d6aa86caef4ae4246f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596967/d060548c88fefe19ee97dcbf9af53f9ccd160f13.jpg[/img]

The game is also available for pre-order in a standard retail format! The soundtrack is also coming to vinyl! It's all happening! 

Here's a fun little video we whipped up to celebrate the launch (featuring the Herbert plush toy and Thomasina's voice actor, the one and only Samantha Béart - aka Karlach from Baldur's Gate 3)

[previewyoutube=23sCMUdtDsI;full][/previewyoutube]

We are extremely honoured to be part of this first wave of Lost in Cult's EDITIONS series alongside IMMORTALITY and Thank Goodness You're Here!

For further details and to place your pre-order, [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/]visit Lost in Cult here. [/url]

We hope you like it! 

Thanks for your support,

Shaun, John & Laurie
[i]Cloak and Dagger Games[/i]

notes.title: Hob's Barrow plushie campaign! - Starts October 7!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We are launching a [b]Makeship Petition[/b] on October 7th to hopefully create a [i]plushie [/i]of our dear creepy little friend [b]Herbert the cat[/b]! This is your chance to bring him to life... [i]if you dare![/i]

You can sign up on the Makeship page to get an alert when the Petition goes live: https://www.makeship.com/petitions/herbert-the-cat-from-the-excavation-of-hobs-barrow


[i]How do Makeship Petitions work?[/i]
Once the Petition is fully live (on October 7) you can pledge $2 toward your plushie. We need 200 unique supporters to pledge $2 to make Herbert come to life and kickstart a full Campaign! You'll then be charged the remaining balance automatically when the Campaign launches. The full standard retail price for a plushie on Makeship is $29.99 (plus p&p)

If the Petition fails to reach 200 supporters, you will receive a refund of your $2. 

[i]Why Herbert?[/i]
We originally had the idea to create a plushie quite a while ago, so we ran a poll on Twitter to see who people might like to see as a plushie. Herbert won, with Thomasina a very distant second!

[i]Why can't I see the plushie design?[/i]
Makeship only create the design and produce the plushie if 200 people pledge in the petition, this is their business model. If the Petition is successful, we will work closely with their designers to bring Herbert to life. Makeship are renowned for making high quality plushies, you can see some of their current designs here: https://www.makeship.com/shop/featured


We are very excited about this one! If you'd like to bring a Herbert into your life this is your chance - and your support is very much appreciated :)

Many thanks,
Shaun
[i][b]Cloak and Dagger Games[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36596967/fc6c1d350922707da5d5c814ee75fed8e53982ad.png[/img]

notes.title: 2023 BAFTA Games Awards - longlist nominee!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

With great pleasure we can belatedly announce that [b]Samantha Béart (Thomasina Bateman) [/b]was longlisted for this year's [b]BAFTA Games Awards[/b] in the [b]Performer in a Leading Role[/b] category: one of the top 10 performances as voted by BAFTA members in 2023!

BAFTA recently announced that going forward from 2024, longlisted nominees will be published online. In the past, longlisted nominees were sworn to secrecy unless they made the final shortlist (top 6 performances). This was very hard to keep quiet! BAFTA has now given us special permission to publicly share Samantha's longlist nomination - something we are very proud of! I think we can all agree Samantha truly brought Thomasina to life - an incredible performance! 

Thanks for your continued support for The Excavation of Hob's Barrow, we really appreciate it. It's been a crazy ride since release, thanks for sharing it with us! :)

With love,
Shaun, John and Laurie
[i][b]Cloak and Dagger Games[/b][/i]

notes.title: Patch v1.05
notes.content:
If you want to switch to 3.6 version of AGS (there is no need to do so, but if you're experiencing some issues with input, it will help) for you can do so by following the instructions:
1) Right click The Excavation of Hobs Barrow,
2) Properties
3) Betas
4) typing in that text input box "testformactest" WITHOUT QUOTES, hitting check code
5) Hitting the blue button that will appear (i believe it will write "Opt into mactest")
6) The game will begin downloading files and once that's done, you'll have the same but hopefully the issue will be resolved!

List of fixes:
-Fixed some texts regarding a poem.
-Fixed the darkness level on some objects so that they are more visible.
-Fixed clarity of click to advance dialogue option.

notes.title: The Excavation of Hob's Barrow is being published by Wadjet Eye Games!
notes.content:
We are [i]thrilled [/i]to finally be able to announce this - our folk horror adventure [b]THE EXCAVATION OF HOB'S BARROW[/b] is being published by Wadjet Eye Games! It has been truly an honour and a privilege to work with such a legendary publisher, one who counts Unavowed, Primordia, Technobabylon, Gemini Rue and Blackwell series among their catalogue of classics! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182310/The_Excavation_of_Hobs_Barrow/

[i]Wait, wasn't this game called INCANTAMENTUM?[/i]
Yes, it was. After discussions with various people who know what they are talking about, the consensus was that INCANTAMENTUM is a bit hard to remember/spell/pronounce for some folk. Interestingly, The Excavation of Hob's Barrow was our original working title for the game, so it was easy for us to make the switch! Rest assured nothing else about the game has changed in any way. 

Working with Wadjet Eye Games means we've been able to expand and polish the game well beyond our initial hopes. The game now has full voice acting from a cast of great professional actors, and will also be coming to Mac and Linux! 

You might notice the game is still referred to as INCANTAMENTUM on certain areas of Steam, with the old promo images - these might take a few days to clear away. 

The game will be released later this year. 

Thanks for your support! 

Shaun
Cloak and Dagger Games
